fonts.display: 'Founders Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Founders Grotesk Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, hairlines, ghost button borders, product card outlines, icon strokes — the dominant structural color; sets all copy and dividers against white and cream surfaces

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page canvas, product card backgrounds, inverse text on black buttons and dark imagery

palette.name: Parchment Cream
palette.role: Warm accent surface, hairline borders, subtle highlight washes — the only chromatic note in the system; appears sparingly as tint, never as bold fill, to echo natural ingredient warmth without competing with photography

palette.name: Ash Gray
palette.role: Disabled/placeholder surfaces, secondary background panels behind product imagery

palette.name: Stone Gray
palette.role: Soft secondary surface, muted card backgrounds for non-primary content blocks

palette.name: Pencil Gray
palette.role: Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color
